routing.purpose: Cross-surface proactive skill routing for Claude Code (UserPromptSubmit) and Cursor (beforeSubmitPrompt + always-apply rule). High-confidence routes reinforce native skill selection while preserving model judgment, explicit-only boundaries, and narrow composition. Recommendation never grants mutation authority.

routes.note: hint_allowed — Read Diagnose path; remediate-until-green routes via pr_remediation_until_green (below) under packet bounds.

Invoking /l9-pr-remediation authorizes merge of all open PRs in the target repo after Converge (green + mergeable, oldest-first, stack-safe). Verify with make pr-check; publish with PR_REMEDIATE=0 make pr. Campaigns/make pr stay no-merge. Force-push and admin-merge remain forbidden. Receipt: ops/autonomy/authorize_merge.py --all-open.
explicit_only + hint_allowed — Read Diagnose path only; Converge mutate requires explicit fix/remediate/unblock/babysit or autonomy packet. PR green/merge stays on l9-pr-remediation.

positive_signals: compile this prompt into a skill
turn this workflow into a skill
add lint type checking and tests

routes.note: model_allowed — Read and follow. Invoking this skill authorizes make campaign INTENT= for the named seed. Publication and merge remain a separate governed release transition.
explicit_only + hint_allowed — Read/attach only; human approve required for console.py --mode run. Recommendation grants no mutation authority.

explicit_only + hint_allowed — recommendation is routing evidence only (source: explicit_hint); requires /autonomy or explicit user campaign authority (campaign authorization packet). Never mutate from a hint alone.
